exposure_interpretation: Environment request metadata only, no rewards, generated trajectory or peer outcome labels read to choose these tasks. Includes interrupted requests; all 20 task IDs also have prior completed episodes. No unrun task is recategorized as online executed.
static_exposure: All 114 public tasks were already parsed/inspected in earlier static audits and split curation; archive E2/E3 also touched historical public trajectories. Selected tasks are only held out from new online optimization/selection, not pristine or training-contamination-free.
closure_definition: Start with all frozen structural groups; add explicit identity links and listed conservative semantic-risk hyperedges; compute full transitive connected components. Semantic edges are bounded reviewer risk judgments, not proof of task equivalence or statistical independence. Do not merge on catalog SKU, generic authentication/confirmation, or one common tool alone.

asset_quarantine.reason: No reference database mutation and no NL assertion; transfer intent is not adequately discriminated by the current native reward. Policy-only audit material, not automatic endpoint filler.

Static reference actions exchange_delivered_order_items then modify_pending_order_items target the same order. Tools require mutually exclusive order statuses; no model/result replay was used to diagnose this. Requires separate reference-asset adjudication.

maximum_claim_limit: 10 is the complete eligible subset under this explicitly conservative risk graph and asset exclusions, not a proven global maximum of semantic-independent problems in tau2. No recovery of quarantined tasks after seeing G4 results.
opportunity_denominator_rule: At registration freeze task-level opportunities from the public task contract plus fixed policy, before new trajectories. Use assigned family x repeat as denominator, retain not-reached/user-invalid/unknown/interrupted separately; do not construct denominators from emitted errors or actual tool calls. No non-retail opportunity in selected new families.

episode_budget_revision.note: Episode counts only, no new CLI/token/time authorization or model invocation. Identical-policy dedup and adoption rules need formal preregistration.
